name: Oocyte (egg cell)
short_description: The largest human cell (~100–120 µm), arrested in meiosis II at ovulation, wrapped in the glycoprotein zona pellucida and a corona of cumulus cells; packed with nutrient stores, mitochondria and cortical granules that block polyspermy after fertilisation.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; large cutaway sphere with thick pale zona pellucida shell, attached corona radiata + looser cumulus oophorus follicle cells, muted educational palette with thin clean outlines matching the house look; interior shows barrel-shaped meiotic spindle, single first polar body in the perivitelline space, thin subcortical band of cortical granules, dispersed teal mitochondria, pale lipid/yolk granules and a small Golgi/ER cluster; no text/border, single specimen, structures well separated for labelling)

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single large smooth oocyte with a fine microvillar fringe and an attached ring of smaller rounded follicle cells (corona radiata/cumulus), false-color sandy-cream vs dusty-rose palette on a dark charcoal background, surface-only detail as correct for SEM, no text/border)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; translucent zona pellucida shell over the ooplasm with correct interior structures and natural tints, but the attached follicle cells only cover two partial arcs rather than a full ring — superseded for a more complete corona/cumulus wrap)
3d.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full ring of attached follicle cells, correct cutaway anatomy incl. spindle/polar body/Golgi cluster/cortical-granule band, natural tones, but follicle-cell tint is sage-green, inconsistent with the pink corona/cumulus used across the other three styles — superseded for palette consistency)
3d.3: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full ring of pink-toned follicle cells (matches textbook/sem/watercolor palette), clean equatorial cutaway revealing ooplasm with dispersed mitochondria/lipid granules, barrel-shaped spindle, single first polar body, Golgi/ER cluster and a cortical-granule band along the cut plane; soft global illumination, no text/border — used as final, annotated)

watercolor.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full-bleed aged paper, correct anatomy incl. spindle/polar body/cortical-granule band/Golgi cluster/lipid droplets, but two thin stray coiled tendril lines extend from the follicle cluster off-canvas — minor unrequested artifact, superseded)
watercolor.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full-bleed aged paper filling the frame edge-to-edge, clean single specimen with corona radiata ring distinct from the looser cumulus oophorus cluster, correct cutaway anatomy, black ink linework and soft washes, no stray artifacts, no text/border — used as final, annotated with black-on-paper label ink)
